decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit builds directly on the firm's core knowledge of dental and medical lab equipment and impression materials, and it has had its own page for two consecutive years, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it.

The orthopedic shoe last extends the firm's existing custom-fit, digital-manufacturing know-how into a new orthopedic field where its related knowledge is only partial, but one year is too short for the firm to learn from early results, so it keeps the product while it builds up knowledge.

The post-curing unit is closely tied to the firm's 3D-printing and curing workflow expertise and complements its established equipment line, so the firm can readily absorb feedback and improve it, even though so far it is only mentioned on the website.
